comment: WORLDMAP.md 6.7. The world map carries 29 placeholder door events on the 21 of its 29 sites that have nothing behind them yet, and they are deliberately INERT: a page whose command list is just the terminator, so Game_Event.start never runs it. This asserts that in the engine rather than in the data, because the day somebody wires the first real transfer is the day this stops being true for one of them and nothing else would say so. Frostwick (61,21) and Village 1 (60,61) are the two walked onto here; the Former Premises is checked from the data because it can only be reached by air.

steps.label: the world map is 120x120 and installed

29 placeholder doors left. It was 41 on 29 sites; Penultima's two, Restwell's two, the Hithermost cluster's four - Village A is two cells, and the chapel and the Door into the Mountain one each - Fairholme's three - Castle A is two cells, and Mrs Emberthwaite's lair one - and Olde Evermore's one, Village C, are real doors now and are in this game's own block of events, which is what wiring a site does - see WORLDMAP.md 7.6. This number goes down by the width of a stamp every time somebody builds a room, and that is the check
and every page of every one of them has no commands at all
with what the page used to say moved into the note, where the editor shows it and nothing runs it

steps.comment: Frostwick's western door cell is one square north. Walking onto it must start nothing.

steps.label: there is an event on this square
THE POINT: walking onto it starts nothing - no chime, no window, no transfer to a room that does not exist
